stories.title: Allies unite behind Saudi Arabia as Houthis step up attacks

en.title: Allies unite behind Saudi Arabia as Houthis step up attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan will hold an urgent high-level meeting under their joint defense pact to coordinate support for the Kingdom facing Houthi attacks. The Iran-aligned Houthis have targeted Yemen's UN-recognized government and struck Saudi Arabia, disrupting oil exports.

stories.title: Nepal PM says floods ‘a warning to the world’ about climate change

en.title: Nepal PM says floods 'a warning to the world' about climate change
en.summary: Nepal's Prime Minister addressed the UN General Assembly, characterizing recent severe flooding as a warning about climate change dangers. He called on countries to help Nepal adapt to warming-related hazards affecting the Himalayan region.

stories.title: Makkah defense pact ministers condemn attacks on Saudi Arabia, plan urgent military talks

en.title: Makkah defense pact ministers condemn attacks on Saudi Arabia, plan urgent military talks
en.summary: Foreign ministers from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey met in New York to discuss the Makkah Joint Defense Agreement and condemned attacks on Saudi Arabia. They reviewed progress on establishing the pact's institutional structures and working groups.

stories.title: Rich Nations Should Foot Climate Bill, Says Nepal Minister

en.title: Rich Nations Should Foot Climate Bill, Says Nepal Minister
en.summary: A Nepal minister argued that wealthy nations should bear the financial responsibility for addressing climate change impacts.

stories.title: Lebanon PM Tells Iran President Country Cannot Be Arena for Regional Wars

en.title: Lebanon PM Tells Iran President Country Cannot Be Arena for Regional Wars
en.summary: Lebanon's Prime Minister communicated to Iran's President that Lebanon should not become a battleground for regional conflicts.

stories.title: Some 60 Ships Passed Through Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, US Official Says

en.title: Some 60 Ships Passed Through Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, US Official Says
en.summary: A US official reported that approximately 60 ships transited through the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday.

stories.title: What Washington’s defense pledge to Saudi Arabia means as Houthi attacks intensify

en.title: What Washington's defense pledge to Saudi Arabia means as Houthi attacks intensify
en.summary: U.S. defense commitments to Saudi Arabia focus on military equipment, operational expertise, and intelligence as Houthi attacks on Saudi territory and regional waterways increase.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia calls for Gaza recovery, unobstructed humanitarian access

en.title: Saudi Arabia calls for Gaza recovery, unobstructed humanitarian access
en.summary: Saudi Arabia urged accelerated recovery efforts in Gaza and unrestricted humanitarian assistance ahead of winter, while calling for full implementation of ceasefire and reconstruction phases. A Saudi special envoy represented the Kingdom at a New York peace roundtable.

stories.title: Saudi ambassador presents letters of credence to Swedish king

en.title: Saudi ambassador presents letters of credence to Swedish king
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's new ambassador to Sweden presented her credentials to King Carl XVI Gustaf. The ambassador conveyed greetings from Saudi leadership and discussed strengthening bilateral relations and cooperation.

stories.title: Middle East wars are weakening UN, Comoros president tells General Assembly

en.title: Middle East wars are weakening UN, Comoros president tells General Assembly
en.summary: The Comoros president told the UN General Assembly that ongoing Middle Eastern conflicts undermine the organization's credibility and ability to maintain global peace.

stories.title: US official: 60 ships passed through Strait of Hormuz in one day

en.title: US official: 60 ships passed through Strait of Hormuz in one day
en.summary: Approximately 60 commercial vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, carrying the highest daily crude oil volume since early July. About 40 vessels coordinated with US military forces for protection during passage.

stories.title: Civil Defense Announces Danger Has Passed in Five Saudi Cities, Including Makkah

en.title: Civil Defense Announces Danger Has Passed in Five Saudi Cities, Including Makkah
en.summary: Saudi Civil Defense declared that a threat situation has ended in five cities, including Makkah.

stories.title: ‎SLB awarded 4 contracts by Aramco to develop 450 wells

en.title: SLB awarded 4 contracts by Aramco to develop 450 wells
en.summary: SLB has secured four integrated well construction contracts from Aramco to develop over 450 oil and gas wells across Saudi Arabia over three years, with a possible two-year extension.

stories.title: ‎Changes in major shareholders’ ownership on Sept. 21

en.title: Changes in major shareholders' ownership on Sept. 21
en.summary: Major shareholders modified their ownership positions on September 21.

en.title: IA suspends ACIG's comprehensive motor policies
en.summary: The Insurance Authority suspended Allied Cooperative Insurance Group from issuing comprehensive motor insurance policies effective September 24, 2026, following regulatory violations.

en.title: CMCER board withdraws capital hike recommendation
en.summary: Canadian Medical Center Co.'s board withdrew its recommendation for a capital increase through bonus share issuance and will reconsider the proposal after reviewing 2026 financial statements.

stories.title: ‎CMA seeks public input on algorithmic trading restrictions

en.title: CMA seeks public input on algorithmic trading restrictions
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Capital Market Authority is requesting feedback from market participants on proposed regulatory provisions for algorithmic trading. The 30-day consultation period ends October 24, 2026, with the aim of enhancing market integrity and efficiency while preventing disruption.
